escalations.detail: Corporate brief evidences a portfolio thesis: Peerless sits under Elevate Fence Partners (operating platform) which sits under Akoya Capital Partners (PE sponsor, Jan 2023 acquisition) alongside 5 sibling brands (Allied, Florida State, Jan, My Fence and Railings 2 Go, Foremost). The proposal-content.json has NO portfolioContext block. Mira's technical trigger (company_context.json.corporateStack.operatingPlatform) does NOT fire because company_context.json does not carry a corporateStack field — Vera wrote the portfolio data directly into the corporate-brief flow, bypassing company_context. This is a Petra-side gap surfaced through Mira but not auto-resolvable.
escalations.resolution: human required — choose: (a) add a portfolioContext block to proposal-content.json with templateAngle referencing Elevate Fence Partners + sibling brands (use hawk.json talkingPoint pattern verbatim once defined), or (b) accept that the corporate brief stands as a separate document the buyer reads first and is sufficient. Recommended: option (a) — the proposal closes the deal, the brief opens it; the platform thesis should appear in both.
